Episodes.Title: The Labyrinth
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: There is a poisoning at Versailles. Fabien rescues the Dauphin from Rohan. Philippe, still reeling from Henriette's death, refuses to return to Versailles.

Episodes.Title: A Still Small Voice
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Philippe is ordered to marry Princess Palatine to secure a German alliance, just as the Chevaliers exile is lifted. Louis hosts a ball for Palatines arrival. Another poisoning takes place.

Episodes.Title: Who Will Watch the Watchmen?
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Montespan gives birth. Sophie is ordered to marry Cassel. Marie-Thérèse grows jealous of Louis's mistress. Philippe must be seen bedding Princess Palatine, much to the Chevaliers jealousy.

Episodes.Title: Miasma
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Madeleine de Foix is arrested as the poisoner after trying to kill Fabien. Montespans baby suffers an illness. Louis faces criticism from Bossuet and Pascal. Sophie endures a terrifying experience when married to Cassel.

Episodes.Title: War and Peace
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: King Louis XIV's continued insomnia makes him increasingly volatile, meaning Marchal's loyalty counts for nothing. Claudine continues to investigate the mystery toxin, while Sophie seeks a solution to her situation.

Episodes.Title: The Sands of Time
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Tim Loane
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: A delegation arrives, but won't negotiate with the queen. Phillipe steps up to act as king while Louis is at battle. Fabien mourns Claudine and seeks to avenge her murder. The king's mistress takes her jealousy too far.

Episodes.Title: A Night
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis meets Guillaume d'Orange in a relentless combat and returns to Versailles full of new energy. The court is in shock of two new deaths and Montespan feels herself increasingly isolated.

Episodes.Title: Le nouveau régime
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis ends his relationship with Madame De Montespan who full of humiliation turns to dark forces. Palatine is suffering of suspected poisoning and Cassel reveals Thomas' secret plans to the king.

Episodes.Title: Seven Shadows
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Tim Loane
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: Louis has Phillipe get close to the spy. This ignites the Chevalier's jealousy. Fabien learns what Father Etienne does with the children he rescues. Montespan is desperate to reclaim the king's love, but Louis falls for someone mo...

Episodes.Title: Of Blood and Stone
Episodes.Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Episodes.Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Episodes.Plot: The affair of the poisons continues. Could it even reach deep into Louis's own court?
